issues.description: Method getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor(): return type is inconsistent across artifacts. In problem_statement.md (UML) the method is declared as getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor(): int (line 72). In the template (src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java) the TODO hint explicitly states the return type should be double for precise calculation (line 17). In the solution (src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java) the implemented method signature is public double getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor() (line 85). This mismatch can confuse students about the expected signature and may cause compilation or test failures if they follow the UML instead of the template/solution.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the return type across all artifacts.
